name: stage_comes_from_the_cli
why: the stage is read from the records by the CLI, never decided by the session

name: stages_run_through_the_skill_tool
pattern: Run each stage through the `Skill` tool
why: the owner: chaining must not affect quality; each stage is the real command, loaded whole

name: nothing_is_lighter
pattern: Nothing in them is lighter here
why: a quick run is the four regular commands with every gate

name: stages_start_from_records
pattern: Each stage starts from the records
why: no stage leans on what the session remembers of an earlier one

name: no_stop_between_stages
why: the chain goes on by itself; the Stop hook enforces it

name: branch_is_the_persons
pattern: Never create, switch, merge, rebase, push or delete it
why: the owner branches off and decides what happens to the branch afterwards

name: start_passes_the_item
why: the run is started and bound to the branch by the CLI

name: finish_is_the_cli
why: the close checks that every builder of the run is gone

name: no_drop_or_land_unasked
pattern: Never run `shipyard-data quick drop` or `shipyard-data quick land` unless the person asks

name: records_are_separate
pattern: the regular sprint and backlog of this project are not touched
why: the owner: ship-quick must not mix with the normal flow

name: tutorial_flag_in_argument_hint
pattern: argument-hint: "\[what to build, in words \| S### \| E### \| IDEA-### \| ticket key\] \[--tutorial \[--sandbox\]\]"
why: the guided run is a flag on the quick run, not a command of its own

name: tutorial_narration_is_the_clis
why: the words are in one file and tested; the session adds none of its own

name: tutorial_blocks_shown_as_they_are
pattern: Show every such block to the person as it is, before the stage's work
why: a TUTORIAL block is CLI output the person must see, like every other CLI output

name: tutorial_first_card
why: one card, three answers, before any stage

name: tutorial_pick_stage
why: a tutorial that opened without an item sets one through the CLI

name: tutorial_changes_nothing_else
why: every stage runs whole, on the project's own models and settings
